products.title: Metformin Guide
products.description: Understand what metformin research can—and cannot—tell you, with comparisons across infections, neurological conditions, individual cancers and physical function.
products.readiness: We are reconciling the metformin sources, corrections and study assessments before writing the complete guide. It is not yet available to buy. The free article remains available.
scope: Research on metformin, with established and investigated uses kept separate.
Findings will remain tied to the studied condition, population, treatment context and outcome. Essential safety information stays available in the free article.
chapters: Quick orientation: what metformin is and what is being investigated
How metformin works: established actions and proposed mechanisms
Infections and Long COVID: prevention versus treatment
Neurological conditions: Parkinson’s disease and schizophrenia research
Cancer research: separate findings for each cancer and setting
Physical function: muscle, training and frailty studies
Understanding conflicting findings and effect sizes
Safety, formulations and questions about monitoring
Preparing a medical discussion: checklists, FAQs and worksheets
Glossary, linked sources, contributors and edition changes
